profile.headline: C/C++ Linux, Real-Time, and Embedded Developer
profile.summary: C/C++ software developer with 20 years experience delivering real-time, embedded, and system software.  Experience with bare-metal firmware, embedded RTOS, Android, Linux kernel device drivers.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: C++ developer for real-time trading systems.  Extensive use of template metaprogramming for optimization and reusability.  Used SolarCapture EFVI to implement a kernel-bypass network packet capture application to aggregate all customer traffic for real-time analysis.  Designed and implemented an out-of-band open outcry trade matching application to simplify logic and messaging of the trade matching engine.  Worked with a team to port acquired international exchanges to Cboe technology, adding required capabilities and features.  Created various developer productivity tools including a visualization tool for the proprietary IPC messaging protocol.

company.name: Bats Global Markets (now Cboe Global Markets)

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Designer and developer of embedded firmware and drivers for remote monitoring products.  Created two complete bare metal software platforms, one for Cortex-M4, the other for Coldfire v1.  Both include drivers for ADC, SPI, I2C, flash, EEPROM, RTC, and more, as well as system- and application-level software, and both are used as the basis for several products.  Lead developer of a cross-platform telemetry module, supporting satellite, GSM, and CDMA communications.  Brought up from scratch a Cortex A9 platform to run mainline U-boot and Linux for use as a general purpose computer, as well as the base for new products.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software · C · Linux Kernel · Device Drivers · ARM Cortex-M

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: System-level developer working on Linux and Android platforms and in-house proprietary operating system.  Develop and debug hardware drivers for sensors, wireless devices, audio and video outputs, HID controls and more.  Develop and maintain system level services such as secure software updates and configuration backend.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Device Drivers · Linux Kernel · Bootloader

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Embedded system designer for veterinary telemedicine project.  Implemented zigbee-based wireless communication network, and developed signal processing algorithms for monitoring animal behavior.
